Doggy Day Out: take a shelter dog for a walk, home visit or pup cup, Tue-Sun 10:30-5:30; apply via the Doggy Day Out application (Shelterluv) on the page or call (941) 474-7887 x413. Weekend Warrior: take a dog home for a weekend (can start Wednesday). Shelter at 2620 Worth Ave, Englewood.
